title: a16z Leads $870M Funding Round for TypeSafe AI
summary:
The creators of the Jev AI model now command a $7.5 billion valuation after attracting usage from 29.4% of the Fortune 500 and serving trillions of tokens daily. TypeSafe AI raised approximately $870 million in a Series A round led by Andreessen Horowitz, with participation from Sequoia and other investors. The company has already reached profitability after accounting for expenses and scaled these operations within 3 weeks of its product launch.

CEO Diogo aims to provide developers with "primitives of intelligence" to empower builders rather than simply automating current software processes. Andreessen Horowitz, also known as a16z, stated the investment follows a belief that AI should make software more powerful instead of merely recreating existing tools.

selectedTweets.text:
We’re so excited to announce that we’re leading TypeSafe AI's Series A:

"Like @TypeSafeAI, we believe the future of SaaS and software is bright. And AI should make software more powerful, and not just automate the recreation of existing software. This spiritual alignment goes back many years. We’ve long been fans of Diogo, the founder and CEO of TypeSafe, and have resonated strongly with his vision that the true bitter lesson is not necessarily about building a new being, but returning the power to builders by giving them the primitives of intelligence then letting them unleash their imagination.

The entire a16z team is excited to partner with TypeSafe. Software continues to eat the world."

By @JenniferHli, @sarahdingwang, @martin_casado, @pmarca, and @bhorowitz
